segments.comment: A dwarvish Archeologist creates a soldier, waits until it wields a cursed short sword, then lashes it with his bullwhip. apply.c use_whip() reports "It is welded to his hand." with mhis(mtmp), not the monster's name. The setup needs a cursed weapon from makemon.c m_initweap(): seeds 900417-900426 under this character and date were recorded and 900419 and 900423 had the soldier weld its weapon; 900419 is used.
